comment: Read from the maker's source at the 2.0.2 release, which is the installed build. Three points where the module differs from what its own tooltips say, each handled in the control's line. First, FRICL is passed to Glottis::setIntensity, which scales the glottal waveform and the aspiration noise; the fricative noise fed into the tract is scaled by fricativeIntensity, which the code fixes at 1.0 with the knob for it commented out, so the knob named Fricative Level does not set the fricative level. Second, MASTERPITCH is configured with displayBase 2 and displayMultiplier 261.63, so Rack reads it out as an exponential frequency, while process computes pitch = 261.63 * (1 + knob), a linear scaling; the two agree only at knob 0 and knob 1. Third, TENSEA, VIBA and VOCTA are configured 0 to 1 and cannot invert, though two of them are named Attenuversion. The FRICQ knob is configured with its minimum above its maximum (1.2 down to 0.00001), so it runs backwards. FRICFC, FRICQ and FRICL each have a small attenuverter added at the same mm2px centre as the large knob, the small one second and therefore on top; both can be clicked, the attenuverter at the centre and the large knob on the ring, so both are described and tagged. TENSE_PARAM is configured twice, the second call setting the name Tenseness and the default 0.44. LIP_PARAM is commented out. This pass checked for a module context menu and a draggable display and found neither: PinkTromboneWidget overrides no appendContextMenu and adds only knobs, jacks and lights, with no custom widget, so the tract can be shaped only from the panel controls. The defaults confirm that the module sounds unattended: FRICL comes up at 0.7325 and Tenseness at 0.44.
